title: CLO 2025.0 New Features Highlights Video: Take a Quick Tour of the Key Updates in This Version!
description: Intelligent, powerful, creating all possibilities—CLO 2025.0 new version officially launched! Join CLO technical experts for a quick overview of the key features in this release~ This version update brings you 9 brand-new features: keyframe animation, panel generator, AI model pose generator, virtual model IK joint mapping, virtual model hip shape adjustment, texture-based fabric spreading, range drag, support for GPU rendering on MAC systems, and real-time hair generation. Additionally, 33 existing features have been upgraded to accelerate and enhance your design experience!
transcript:
Hello everyone, this video will quickly guide you through the new features and highlights of version Kolo 2025.0.  
First is the main function.  
Now you can use our AI model pose generator to create all kinds of poses, making the process of creating poses faster and easier.  
You can not only use the prompt system in the software to quickly generate the pose you want, but also combine text input to generate poses.  
You can also upload reference pictures to generate specific poses.  
After the pose is generated, you can save it to your computer and then apply it to other project files.  
In the new version, we optimized the pattern generator.  
In the current version, you can use it to create a T-shape by simply entering the size.  
The system will generate the corresponding pattern.  
You can also manually adjust the parameters to achieve the desired effect.  
Click to create, and the system will automatically complete the arrangement and sewing of the pattern.  
In addition, we also have the AI pattern generator.  
You can enter a prompt to generate a model image, then create the corresponding pattern based on the model image.  
Click to create.  
You can also try other prompts to create, or upload the design pattern you created to generate the pattern.  
The system will automatically generate the corresponding size pattern through built-in program calculations.  
You can adjust and modify it accordingly.  
Click to create.  
The generated pattern will also be automatically arranged and sewn.  
We also optimized the animation keyframe function in the new version.  
This helps you achieve quick animation editing and provides more editing options for precise control.  
During animation production, you can edit and control various elements more freely, such as gravity settings and color editing, as shown here.  
This feature is part of the new animation editor, which helps you create more exciting and lively animations.  
The new animation editor supports hole viewing in the 3D window to check hair effects, allowing you to quickly judge the hair effect without opening the rendering window.  
Select the hairstyle material type, and you can check the hair effect directly in the 3D window on the left side.  
As you can see, the rendering window can also be displayed simultaneously.  
The print and export functions have also been fully upgraded.  
Now the software can choose to export according to real application and only export the current material, locking it in the current position for arrangement.  
These improvements will unlock more application scenarios for CLO connection production.  
Next, I will introduce the brightness function of the virtual model for you.  
First, the AI model workshop adds generation background options while improving the overall output quality of the image.  
Let's generate a face first.  
You can also upload a face picture.  
Then choose the background.  
You can use the system prompt to generate a picture, which will be combined with the newly generated face image.  
Or enter a specific text description to generate the picture.  
You can also upload a picture to reconstruct the background or display the environment of the costume.  
In addition, the new version adds the virtual model IK joint printing function, which improves compatibility between external virtual models and CLO.  
You only need to easily select the corresponding position in the 3D window or use the automatic printing function.  
You can apply all posture materials in CLO.  
The flip position is a simple and easy-to-use new function added this time.  
You can flip any posture in the 3D window.  
In the new version of the virtual model editor, shape adjustment has been added for the hips and chest.  
For the hips, you can control the curve shape on both sides and adjust how much the hips move up or down.  
For the chest, you can now select and adjust the scale size and apply different chest shapes through a switch option.  
Next, let's introduce the related updates of the 3D window.  
Our UV editor interface has been changed from the previous mode to an editor interface, including the main menu bar, material UV toolbar, and download menu.  
Now in the UV editor, you can view both the front and back sides of the texture.  
All texture views can be displayed.  
When taking a quick photo of the 3D window image, you can choose the colors you want to save, save single or multiple quick photos, and quickly export multiple color quick photos from the project file for display.  
In the rendering window, you can now set the depth for each self-defined view. The method is very simple: use the left mouse button to determine the focal point.  
CLO will automatically apply it to the corresponding self-defined view setting, allowing you to experience the effect in CLO as realistically as in an actual photo.  
Now I will introduce the optimization of the keypad function.  
In CLO, you can use a fake needle to create multiple focal points for a keypad.  
Click on the keypad, then click on the keypad where you want to paste the clipboard to add a focal point.  
With this new function, you can easily create multiple focal points and add multiple fixed positions to a keypad, achieving a more realistic keypad simulation.  
Next, there is a function update related to simulation.  
The new range drag tool helps you control the area range and the strength of the effect when opening the simulation, helping you achieve faster and more accurate clothing adjustments.  
Next are updates regarding the user interface.  
Now when you open a project file, you can choose whether to open and display it according to the display status at the time of saving.  
It is also possible to annotate the layout of the new CLO.  
Click on the new CLO.  
At the same time, you can add previously collected files to the new drawing library and transfer them to the label page of the new drawing library, where you can rename them.  
Now let's look at the function updates related to materials.  
You can now directly switch colors by clicking the color block in the object window, and you can use shortcut keys to open the color editor.  
You can check and adjust the front, back, or side colors of the fabric in the color editor, making it easier to edit material colors.  
Next, I will introduce the optimization of the label function.  
You can now open the 2D window and set relevant label information settings for the pattern, such as font size, color, and direction, making label information clearer.  
Finally, let's look at the brightness function update for 2D CAD.  
The generated round and smooth curve tool has been optimized.  
On the basis of the original usage method, a new method has been added to adjust the curve shape, allowing better control and editing of curves.  
You can adjust only the selected curve separately without affecting other parts, achieving freer and more accurate curve adjustments.  
In addition, there are more new functions.  
Welcome to the latest version of CLO.  
Please keep following us.

chunks.title: CLO 2025.0 New Features Highlights Video: Take a Quick Tour of the Key Updates in This Version!
chunks.content: # CLO 2025.0 New Features Highlights This document details the key updates and new features introduced in CLO 2025.0, including AI-powered pose and pattern generation, animation enhancements, virtual model improvements, 3D window and UV editor updates, simulation tools, user interface refinements, material editing, label customization, and 2D CAD optimizations. --- ## AI Pose Generator This section covers the new AI model pose generator designed to accelerate pose creation using prompts, images, and text inputs. - **Pose Generation Methods:** - Generate poses using the built-in prompt system. - Combine text input with prompts for customized pose creation. - Upload reference images to create specific poses. - **Post-Generation:** - Save generated poses locally. - Apply saved poses to other project files for reuse. --- ## Pattern Generation Enhancements Focuses on improvements to the pattern generator, including manual adjustments and AI-driven pattern creation. - **Pattern Generator:** - Create a T-shape pattern by entering size parameters. - Manual parameter adjustments available for customization. - Automatic arrangement and sewing of patterns upon creation. - **AI Pattern Generator:** - Generate model images from prompts to create corresponding patterns. - Upload custom design patterns to generate size-accurate patterns using built-in calculations. - Automatic arrangement and sewing applied to generated patterns. - Multiple prompt attempts supported for varied pattern creation. --- ## Animation Editor and Keyframe Optimization Describes new animation editing tools and keyframe functionality for precise and efficient animation control. - **Animation Keyframe Function:** - Enhanced for quick editing with more control options. - Edit elements such as gravity and color settings during animation production. - **New Animation Editor Features:** - Supports hole viewing in the 3D window for hair effect inspection without rendering. - Select hairstyle material types and preview hair effects directly in the 3D window. - Rendering window can be displayed concurrently for comparison. --- ## Print and Export Upgrades Details improvements in print and export options tailored for real-world applications. - Export functions now allow selection of materials to export. - Lock materials in their current arrangement position. - Expands scenarios for CLO connection production workflows. --- ## Virtual Model Enhancements Introduces updates related to virtual model creation, background generation, IK joint printing, and body shape adjustments. - **AI Model Workshop:** - Added background generation options. - Improved overall image output quality. - Upload or generate face images and backgrounds via system prompts or text descriptions. - Upload custom images to reconstruct backgrounds or costume environments. - **Virtual Model IK Joint Printing:** - Improved compatibility with external virtual models. - Select joint positions in the 3D window manually or use automatic printing. - Apply all posture materials in CLO seamlessly. - **Flip Position Function:** - Flip any posture directly in the 3D window easily. - **Shape Adjustment in Virtual Model Editor:** - Hips: Control curve shape on both sides and vertical positioning. - Chest: Adjust scale size and switch between different chest shapes.

chunks.content: - **Virtual Model IK Joint Printing:** - Improved compatibility with external virtual models. - Select joint positions in the 3D window manually or use automatic printing. - Apply all posture materials in CLO seamlessly. - **Flip Position Function:** - Flip any posture directly in the 3D window easily. - **Shape Adjustment in Virtual Model Editor:** - Hips: Control curve shape on both sides and vertical positioning. - Chest: Adjust scale size and switch between different chest shapes. --- ## 3D Window and UV Editor Updates Covers interface redesign and new features for texture viewing, quick photo capture, and rendering customization. - **UV Editor Interface:** - Redesigned with main menu bar, material UV toolbar, and download menu. - View both front and back sides of textures. - Supports displaying all texture views. - **3D Window Quick Photo Function:** - Choose colors to save. - Save single or multiple quick photos. - Export multiple color quick photos simultaneously from the project file. - **Rendering Window Improvements:** - Set depth per self-defined view using mouse to select focal point. - CLO automatically applies settings for realistic photographic effects. --- ## Keypad Function Optimization Explains new functionality for creating multiple focal points on a keypad for enhanced simulation realism. - Use a fake needle to create multiple focal points on a keypad. - Click to add focal points at desired locations. - Enables multiple fixed positions for realistic keypad behavior. --- ## Simulation Tool Updates Details the new range drag tool to enhance control during simulation. - Control the area range affected by simulation. - Adjust the strength of simulation effects. - Enables faster and more precise clothing adjustments. --- ## User Interface Improvements Summarizes enhancements related to project file handling and annotation features. - Option to open project files with the display status saved at the time of closing. - Annotate layouts within the new CLO interface. - Add previously collected files to a new drawing library. - Transfer files to label pages in the drawing library with renaming support. --- ## Material Editing Features Highlights updates to color editing and material management. - Switch colors directly by clicking color blocks in the object window. - Shortcut keys available to open the color editor. - Edit front, back, and side fabric colors easily within the color editor. --- ## Label Function Optimization Focuses on expanded label customization options in the 2D window. - Set label information such as font size, color, and direction. - Makes label data clearer and more customizable for patterns. --- ## 2D CAD Brightness and Curve Tool Enhancements Describes improvements to curve editing tools for more precise 2D CAD work. - Optimized round and smooth curve tool. - New method to adjust curve shape independently. - Allows selective adjustment of curves without affecting other parts. - Enables freer and more accurate curve modifications. --- # Summary CLO 2025.0 introduces significant advancements in AI-assisted pose and pattern generation, animation editing, virtual model realism, and user interface efficiency.
